problems: Example labelling is late or missing: the demo's 'example data from a made-up lab' note sits at the bottom of the card (~1,100px below the data at 390), and the phone mock, spreadsheet and record card have no visible example label.

Accessibility defects found by axe: 2.85:1 contrast on spreadsheet row numbers, empty table header, non-focusable horizontally scrollable table at 390; 'Try' chips are 40px; input focus has no outline.
Mobile recomposition is thin: artifact result starts below the 390 fold, header CTA hidden with no nav, and the demo renders empty without JS; long queries are clipped by overflow:hidden.

reason: A is the page I would rather maintain and ship: zero axe violations, every target at least 44px, a working accessible mobile menu, prerendered artifact that survives no-JS, full edge-case handling with reset, and sample labels placed beside the data. B is clean and well written but has real contrast, focus and labelling gaps and a weaker phone layout. A fix to A's desktop focus order is needed; I would change my mind only if B's labels moved next to its sample data and its axe issues were fixed while A's managers section proved broken in a browser I did not test.
